## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**原始数字（来源：`press_release.txt` 中"Segment Revenue Constant Currency Reconciliation"表）：**
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$39,306M**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$29,878M**

**计算过程：**
- 同比增长 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 = 9,428 / 29,878 = **0.3156 ≈ 32%**
- 恒定汇率口径增长为 31%（来源：同一表格"Constant Currency"列）

结论：**Intelligent Cloud 分部本季度收入同比增长 32%（GAAP），恒定汇率口径增长 31%。**

---

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（引用原话）

以下引自 `transcript.txt` 位置 24500–27500 区间，Amy Hood（CFO）在电话会上的表述：

> **"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."**
>
> **Azure 部分：**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. **Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"
>
> **本地服务器业务部分：**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. **Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

**总结管理层归因因素：**
1. Azure 收入增长 43%，客户需求持续超过可用产能；
2. CPU/GPU 舰队效率提升（efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet）；
3. 流程改进使新产能更早交付（process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity）；
4. 当季新增产能被迅速货币化（additional in-quarter capacity was quickly monetized）；
5. GitHub Copilot 在 6 月商业模式变更（转为使用量定价）后消耗强于预期；
6. 本地服务器续约合同中，当期收入确认占比更高（higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts）。

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| # | 归因表述 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|---------|------|---------|
| 1 | Azure 收入增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 具体数字是对已结束季度（Q4 FY26）的实际业绩报告 |
| 2 | Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity | **现状描述（偏向事实）** | "continues to" 表明这是电话会时点的持续状态；但隐含未来供给仍紧张 |
| 3 | Efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet | **已发生事实** | "driven by" 表示这是 Q4 已实现的效率提升 |
| 4 | Process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity | **已发生事实** | "enable earlier delivery" 描述 Q4 已实现的改进 |
| 5 | Additional in-quarter capacity was quickly monetized | **已发生事实** | "was" 过去时态，描述 Q4 内完成的动作 |
| 6 | GitHub Copilot stronger-than-expected consumption following the June business model change | **已发生事实** | 6 月变更已完成，消耗结果是已实现数据 |
| 7 | On-premises server renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition | **已发生事实** | 描述 Q4 已完成的续约交易结构 |
| 8 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps"（位置 32535） | **前瞻性表述** | "remain focused on" 是面向未来的承诺/意图 |
| 9 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"（位置 32535） | **前瞻性表述** | 明确使用 "continue to expect"，是对未来半年度的预测 |
| 10 | 下季度指引 "we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion... growth of 33% to 34%"（位置 32535） | **前瞻性表述** | 明确使用 "we expect"，是未来季度的定量指引 |

**区分依据总结：**
- **事实类**：使用过去时态（"grew"、"was"、"driven by"）或对已完成季度具体数字的陈述，对应已实现的经营结果。
- **前瞻性表述类**：使用 "expect"、"continue to expect"、"remain focused on"、"we are committed to" 等措辞，或包含对未来的定量指引，对应管理层基于当前判断对后续期间的预期。
